div.div: PreStimTime = 100 ns: longer than any path delay (Baseline STA path 41.7 ns), so every output turns 'X' first and the vector always causes a final transition to measure.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 623px; margin-left: 622px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1F5FBF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#1F5FBF, #70a7f9); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
StableTime = 20 ns: longer than any gap between transitions of a settling output (longest wire hop on a critical path ≈ 2.8 ns).
Timeout = 500 ns: safety limit, so a faulty DUT cannot hang the run.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 770px; margin-left: 622px;

div.div: 'last_event = time since the signal last changed, so (now − T0) − 'last_event is the time of its final transition after the vector was applied. Status = Cout or Ovfl, whichever settled later.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 376px; height: 1px; padding-top: 870px; margin-left: 622px;

div.div: The worst delays and their vector indices are reported in the final line (read by CollectTiming.tcl).
